name: Olympians: Roy
source:
Set, aka Roy, is the leader of your superhero team, "Olympians," founded and formed by the superhero agency, Olympus, to be a united front against any and all who stand against them. As leader and "dad" of the group, and in his own personal life as both a daycare owner, and the sole provider for his little sister, "Cecilia", Roy has his hands full.

You've known Roy since you were teenagers, and as a result he can only really let his guard down with you. Maybe you can help take some of the weight off of his shoulders, sidekick.

[From [url=https://meant-to-bee-studios.itch.io/olympians-roy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
代号“赛特”的罗伊是你所在超级英雄小队“奥林匹斯众神”的队长——这支队伍由超级英雄机构“奥林匹斯”一手创立组建，旨在结成统一战线，迎战一切敢于与他们为敌的势力。身为队里的领袖兼“老爹”，私底下既经营着一家日托中心，又是妹妹“塞西莉亚”唯一的经济支柱，罗伊可谓分身乏术、忙得不可开交。

你与罗伊自十几岁起便已相识，正因如此，唯有在你面前他才能真正卸下防备。或许你可以帮他分担一点肩上的重担，小助手。

[摘自[url=https://meant-to-bee-studios.itch.io/olympians-roy]itch.io[/url]]
